data.summary: The pod startup was slow because the application spent 74.176 seconds waiting to connect to a dependency, http://slow-dependency.kubesage-infra.svc.cluster.local/. This dependency connection repeatedly failed with 'Connection refused' errors. The application was marked Ready immediately after the dependency connection succeeded.

findings.statement: The total startup time was 80.0 seconds, exceeding the SLO of 10.0 seconds.
The application spent 74.176 seconds attempting to connect to a dependency, which accounts for the majority of the 75.097 seconds spent in the app_init phase.
The dependency connection attempts failed with '<urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>' and involved 75 retries.
The pod was marked Ready immediately after the app_init phase completed, with the readiness phase taking 0.0 seconds.

ruled_out.reason: The image pull duration was only 4.484 seconds for an image size of 53328919 bytes, indicating a normal pull throughput of 11893158 bytes/s.
The image pull throughput was 11893158 bytes/s, which is not considered slow.
There was no time spent in model loading, as indicated by a model_s duration of 0.0 seconds.
While app_init was long (75.097 seconds), the primary cause within it was dependency connection, which falls under the 'slow_readiness' category.
The scheduling phase took 0.0 seconds and there were no failed scheduling events, indicating no capacity issues.

recommendations.action: Investigate the availability and responsiveness of the 'http://slow-dependency.kubesage-infra.svc.cluster.local/' dependency.
recommendations.rationale: The application spent 74.176 seconds retrying connections to this dependency, which was consistently refusing connections.

recommendations.action: Consider implementing a startup probe for the pod.
recommendations.rationale: A startup probe could prevent the readiness probe from failing repeatedly during dependency initialisation, allowing the pod to start up more gracefully without being prematurely marked as unhealthy.
